reproduction_target: Re-derive the spatial-transcriptomic and bulk RNA-seq analyses supporting the EGFR-CREB5 proximity-sensing axis: Xenium fibroblast subtype clustering + local-density (KDE) association in RA-remission synovium, micromass organoid time-course pseudo-bulk DE, density-gradient Banksy clustering, siRNA-screen Xenium perturbation scoring, and the bulk RNA-seq salmon->DESeq2 density/knockdown differential expression with GO/PROGENy pathway inference. Wet-lab tissue acquisition, culture, transfection, qRT-PCR, Xenium slide chemistry and western blotting are out of scope (OOS).
granularity_note: No workflow file and no code repository exist; steps derived from Methods prose, one step per named tool/analysis invocation (Seurat, Harmony, presto, spatstat, InSituCor, Banksy, MASS, DESeq2, salmon, tximport, ComBat-seq, PCAtools, clusterProfiler, PROGENy/decoupleR, coseq, UCell, Mixscale, 10x Xenium Analyzer). Steps applied twice to different datasets ('identical preprocessing as described above') are counted once per dataset only where the paper names a separate invocation with its own parameters.

steps.label: Seurat v5 preprocessing of RA-remission synovial tissue Xenium object (normalize scale.factor=5000, 1000 variable features, scale, PCA 20 components)
Harmony batch correction across patient samples (dims.use 1:20, lambda 1)
kNN graph construction + UMAP on Harmony-corrected PCA space (dims 1:20)
Louvain clustering at resolution 0.5 and marker-based annotation of PRG4+ lining / THY1+ sublining fibroblasts
presto R package marker gene detection (AUC > 0.6, adjusted p < 0.05, pct.expressing > 0.1)
spatstat kernel density estimation of local fibroblast density (Diggle bandwidth selection, edge correction, per-cell interpolation)
InSituCor spatial correlation of gene expression with local fibroblast density within 50-micrometre border regions
Seurat v5 preprocessing of micromass organoid Xenium data ('identical single-cell preprocessing and analysis approaches as for synovial tissue')
Pseudo-bulk aggregation of internal fibroblast clusters by sample and timepoint + filtering of genes with >95% zero counts
DESeq2 differential expression on micromass pseudo-bulk (design accounting for timepoint; FDR < 0.1, |log2FC| > 0.5)
Banksy spatially-aware clustering of density-gradient Xenium data (k_geom = 15,30; lambda = 0.2; resolution 0.3)
MASS R package 2D kernel density estimation of local cell density with per-cell interpolation (density-gradient slides)
10x Xenium Analyzer onboard processing: decoding, cell segmentation and count-matrix generation (Xenium Analyzer User Guide CG000584 Rev B)
salmon quasi-mapping transcript quantification of bulk RNA-seq, default parameters, Gencode v44 reference transcriptome
tximport aggregation of transcript-level abundances to gene level
DESeq2 differential expression on bulk RNA-seq (design ~0 + group + patient; FDR < 0.1, |log2FC| > 0.7)
ComBat-seq patient-specific batch correction of normalized bulk counts
PCAtools principal component analysis on batch-corrected counts with 10% variance filtering
clusterProfiler Gene Ontology enrichment on differentially expressed genes (FDR cutoff 0.1)
PROGENy pathway activity inference (top 500 pathway-responsive genes per pathway) run through decoupleR multivariate linear models
Seurat FindMarkers on public AMP RA/SLE Consortium scRNA-seq (immunogenomics.io/ampra2) to derive lining vs sublining signatures (FDR < 0.05, avg log2FC > 0.7)
coseq unsupervised clustering of density-dependent genes (arcsin transformation, k-means K = 2:5) on DESeq2-normalized counts
Seurat v5 preprocessing + FindMarkers on the Xenium siRNA screen (log2FC > 0.7, min.pct = 0.1) to define high/low-density marker sets from control cells
UCell scoring of density-associated marker signatures across siRNA screen conditions
Mixscale perturbation analysis quantifying transcriptional distance between knockdown and control conditions
Arthroscopic synovial tissue collection and CryoStor CS10 cryopreservation (Flinders IRB 396.10; MGB IRB 2019P002924)
Synovial fibroblast isolation by Dispase II / DNase I / Liberase TL digestion and primary culture (passages 2-4)
Cell density seeding experiments (75/150/300/600 cells per mm2 in 96-well; 20/100 cells per mm2 in 6-well)
Synovial micromass organoid culture in Matrigel on poly-HEMA-coated wells (EGM-Plus, 4/7/14/21 days)
Xenium slide preparation and probe hybridization of FFPE micromass (Human Multi-Tissue and Cancer Panel PN-1000626; protocols CG000580 Rev D / CG000582 Rev D)
Post-run H&E staining of Xenium slides (CG000613 Rev A)
Fibroblast density gradient slide preparation (poly-L-lysine + 10% Matrigel coating, 45-degree gravity seeding)
siRNA reverse transfection (Silencer Select, RNAiMAX) including HB-EGF knockdown and non-targeting control
Ligand and forskolin stimulation assays (EGF, HB-EGF, TGF-alpha, forskolin, DMSO vehicle)
Quantitative RT-PCR (TRIzol extraction, QuantiTect RT, Brilliant III SYBR Green on Agilent AriaMx)
Bulk RNA-seq library preparation and sequencing (TCL lysis, ~1750 cells per condition, Smart-Seq2 at the Broad Institute)
Western blotting for CREB5, p-CREB, EGFR, p-EGFR, p-ATF2, SOX5, FOXO1 and loading controls

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 0/25 (0%) readiness upper bound ((n_R-star + n_RI)/S); every computational step fails at least one axis at prose level - no analysis code is deposited and no sequencing/spatial data accession is stated, so no step reaches RI

gaps.missing: The manuscript contains no code availability statement and names no repository (no GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/Software Heritage URL anywhere in the text). All 25 computational steps are described in prose only.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the Seurat/Banksy/DESeq2/coseq/Mixscale analysis scripts in a public repository with a Zenodo DOI and cite it in a Code Availability section.

gaps.missing: Analysis code is private; Code axis scored 1 (reconstructable from named tool + stated thresholds) rather than 2, and cannot exceed 1 anywhere.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the scripts; a re-implementation from prose cannot reproduce cluster assignments, KDE bandwidths or Mixscale distances exactly.

gaps.where: all in-house datasets (synovial tissue Xenium, micromass Xenium, density-gradient Xenium, siRNA-screen Xenium, bulk RNA-seq)
gaps.missing: No Data Availability statement, no GEO/SRA/ENA/ArrayExpress/dbGaP/EGA/Zenodo/figshare accession, and no sample-to-file mapping for any generated dataset. The synovial tissue Xenium object is described only as 'obtained from a previously published Xenium spatial transcriptomic dataset generated in our laboratory' (reference 8) with no accession.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit raw and processed Xenium outputs and bulk RNA-seq FASTQ under stated accessions with a sample manifest linking donor, density condition, siRNA and timepoint.

gaps.missing: Software versions are essentially absent. Only 'Seurat v5' is stated (major version only, no minor/patch); Harmony, presto, spatstat, InSituCor, Banksy, MASS, DESeq2, salmon, tximport, ComBat-seq, PCAtools, clusterProfiler, PROGENy, decoupleR, coseq, UCell and Mixscale are named without any version. No R version, no Bioconductor release, no conda environment, no lockfile, no container.
gaps.how_to_close: Report sessionInfo()/renv.lock or a container digest covering R, Bioconductor release and every named package.

gaps.missing: Cell segmentation and count-matrix generation are performed by proprietary 10x Genomics instrument software; no analyzer software version or segmentation parameter set is reported and the pipeline cannot be re-run outside the vendor instrument.
gaps.how_to_close: Report the Xenium Analyzer software/instrument software version and deposit the raw output bundle so downstream steps can start from a fixed matrix.

gaps.missing: The primary spatial preprocessing sub-pipeline is externalized to vendor instrument software; every downstream Seurat step consumes its output without a version-identified handoff artifact.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the Xenium output bundles (transcripts.parquet / cell_feature_matrix) as the reproducible entry point.

gaps.where: C03, C04, C22 (UMAP, Louvain clustering, coseq k-means); also Harmony initialization
gaps.missing: No random seed is reported for any stochastic step. Cluster labels, UMAP embeddings and k-means partitions are therefore only distributionally comparable.
gaps.how_to_close: Report and demonstrate consumption of a fixed seed, or deposit the resulting cluster assignments.

gaps.where: C14 (salmon, Gencode v44), C19 (clusterProfiler GO annotation)
gaps.missing: The Gencode v44 reference transcriptome is pinned in prose only, with no download URL or checksum and no executable workflow to verify against; the GO/OrgDb annotation snapshot behind clusterProfiler is not identified at all.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin the reference in a download rule with a versioned URL/checksum and state the GO.db/org.Hs.eg.db versions.

gaps.missing: Twelve wet-lab steps (tissue acquisition, fibroblast culture, micromass organoids, Xenium slide chemistry, siRNA transfection, stimulation assays, qRT-PCR, Smart-Seq2 library prep, western blot) are out of scope for computational reproducibility and are excluded from S.

gaps.where: C21 (lining/sublining signature derivation), C24 (UCell signature scoring)
gaps.missing: The derived lining and sublining gene signatures and the density-associated marker sets used for UCell scoring are not provided as supplementary gene lists, so downstream scoring cannot be reproduced even from the public AMP RA/SLE input.
gaps.how_to_close: Supply the final gene lists as supplementary tables.
